info.title: WVN Hackathon Site & Plant Manpower API
info.description:
Authoritative OpenAPI 3.0 specification for WVN Hackathon Site manpower planning, plant operations, employee demographics, and competitor benchmarks.

### Core Domain Rules & Calculation Guidance
1. Plants Catalog: Canonical plants in WVN Site are dynamically linked from hrec_plants. Physical columns are strictly id, name, created_at, updated_at.
2. 11-Day Rolling Forecast (T -> T+10):
   - Workday Baseline: 7-workday moving average of daily Direct Labor leavers prior to reference date T, excluding Sundays.
   - Sunday Rule: Projected leavers on any Sunday = 0.
   - Payday Multiplier (1.5x): On the 11th of each month (or 12th if 11th falls on Sunday), projected leavers = round(avg_leavers * 1.5, 0).
   - Expected Hiring: expected_hiring = standard_manpower_delta + leave_forecast + student_exit_forecast.
3. Query Standards: All endpoints support both flat query parameters (e.g. year=2026&month=10, compatible with AI Agent Function Calling / Dify / OpenAI Tools) and Spatie QueryBuilder standards (filter[...], sort, fields, per_page, page).
4. Uniform Response Envelope: Every response is wrapped with request_id, as_of_date, snapshot_id, source_refreshed_at, data, meta (total, page, per_page), and warnings.

servers.description: Hackathon Site Gateway v1 (Independent REST API)

get.summary: Get daily manpower analyses (system on-job, manpower gap, turnover rate, recruitment demand)
get.description: Queries raw daily manpower analysis records from hrec_plant_daily_analyses with filters for year, month, week, and daily report ID.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Analysis year (2000..2100). (Also accepts filter[year])

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Analysis month (1..12). (Also accepts filter[month])

parameters.name: week
parameters.description: Analysis ISO week number (1..53). (Also accepts filter[week])

parameters.name: plant_daily_report_id
parameters.description: Associated daily operational report ID. (Also accepts filter[plant_daily_report_id])

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort results by field (id, year, month, day, manpower_gap, recruitment_demand)

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Select sparse fieldset columns to return

200.description: Daily manpower analyses wrapped in the Uniform Response Envelope

get.summary: Get daily operational manpower reports (FCST K, PCBA/FA shifts, standard manpower, borrowed manpower)
get.description: Queries raw daily operational report records from hrec_plant_daily_reports dynamically linked with hrec_plants.

parameters.name: plant_id
parameters.description: Filter by plant ID in hrec_plants (supports comma-separated positive integers). (Also accepts filter[plant_id])

parameters.name: date_between
parameters.description: Report date range in YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD format. (Also accepts filter[date_between])

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort results by field (report_date, -report_date, plant_id, standard_manpower, fcst_k)

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Select sparse fieldset columns to return

200.description: Daily operational reports wrapped in the Uniform Response Envelope

get.summary: Get active Direct Labor (DL) headcount baseline at the latest snapshot by plant
get.description: Aggregates active headcount at the latest batch snapshot in fact_employeeinfo_c (recommended focus on manufacturing company codes 6G0, 6Q0, 7J0 via filter[company]).

parameters.name: plant_list
parameters.description: Filter by plant names from hrec_plants (or Site, Managed). (Also accepts filter[plant_list])

parameters.name: plant
parameters.description: Alias filter for plant name. (Also accepts filter[plant])

parameters.name: labor_type
parameters.description: Filter by labor type classification (DL, IDL). (Also accepts filter[labor_type])

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Optional company code filter (recommended focus: 6G0, 6Q0, 7J0), comma-separated. (Also accepts filter[company])

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort results by field (plant, -plant, active_dl_headcount, -active_dl_headcount)

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Select sparse fieldset columns to return

200.description: Active employee baseline headcount by plant wrapped in the Uniform Response Envelope

get.summary: Get Direct Labor (DL) demographic breakdown by plant (age tiers, gender, referral types)
get.description: Breaks down active DL employees by age tier (<18, 18-25, 26-35, 36-45, >45), gender, or referral source type at the latest batch snapshot in fact_employeeinfo_c (recommended company filter: 6G0, 6Q0, 7J0).

parameters.name: plant

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: Breakdown dimension (age, sex, type, all). (Also accepts filter[dimension])

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Optional company code filter (recommended focus: 6G0, 6Q0, 7J0), comma-separated. (Also accepts filter[company])

parameters.name: sort

parameters.name: fields

get.summary: Get historical Direct Labor leavers aggregated by plant and termination date
get.description: Aggregates historical DL employee resignations/terminations (excluding student interns) from fact_employeeinfo_c grouped by plant and termination date.

get.summary: Compute 11-day rolling manpower forecast with Sunday zero-exit & 11th payday multiplier
get.description: Computes day-by-day rolling forecast (T -> T+10) for each plant based on active baseline, 7-workday moving average leavers, calendar rules (Sunday=0 leavers, 11th payday multiplier 1.5x), and scheduled intern exits.

parameters.name: plants
parameters.description: Filter by manufacturing plant names from hrec_plants (e.g. P1,P2,P3,P5). (Also accepts filter[plants])

parameters.name: plant
parameters.description: Alias filter for plant name. (Also accepts filter[plant])

parameters.name: as_of_date
parameters.description: Forecast horizon start date (T) in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to latest batch date). (Also accepts filter[as_of_date])

parameters.name: date_between
parameters.description: Forecast date range in YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD format. (Also accepts filter[date_between])

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Optional company code filter (recommended focus: 6G0, 6Q0, 7J0), comma-separated. (Also accepts filter[company])

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort results by field (date, -date, plant, expected_hiring, leave_forecast)

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Select sparse fieldset columns to return

200.description: Rolling 11-day manpower forecast wrapped in the Uniform Response Envelope
